context_regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: Docetaxel can slow the growth of epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer that has returned or is progressing. Your team reviews symptoms and scans with you to decide whether to continue. One docetaxel infusion over one hour on day 1 of a 21-day cycle. Treatment continues while it is helping and side effects remain manageable.
context_regimen_profiles.treatment_setting: Ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer
context_regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Docetaxel stabilises tiny structures called microtubules. Cells need these to separate their chromosomes during division; disrupting the process can stop cancer cells multiplying. Healthy dividing cells are also affected.
context_regimen_profiles.schedule_context: One docetaxel infusion over one hour on day 1 of a 21-day cycle. Treatment continues while it is helping and side effects remain manageable.
key_points: Take the prescribed steroid starting the day before docetaxel. Ring before attending if you missed a dose. Steroids help prevent allergy and fluid retention.
Full blood count, kidney and liver function. Blood count, kidney and liver function. Symptoms, examination and scans according to your treatment plan.

context_regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: Bevacizumab is given with chemotherapy to help control ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer that has returned and is resistant to platinum. Your team chooses one partner medicine. Bevacizumab every 14 days alongside weekly paclitaxel, weekly topotecan or pegylated liposomal doxorubicin. Your other medicine has its own appointment dates.
context_regimen_profiles.treatment_setting: Ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer
context_regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Binds VEGF, a signal that promotes blood-vessel growth. Blocking VEGF can reduce the blood supply that supports tumour growth; it also affects normal blood vessels and wound healing.
context_regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Bevacizumab every 14 days alongside weekly paclitaxel, weekly topotecan or pegylated liposomal doxorubicin. Your other medicine has its own appointment dates.
key_points: Tell the team before dental surgery or an operation. Starting or restarting bevacizumab after major surgery requires adequate healing and at least 28 days.

Full blood count, kidney and liver function. Blood counts, kidney and liver tests, urine protein, and blood pressure before and after treatment. The team checks your INR weekly until stable, then before each cycle. Symptoms, examination and scans according to your treatment plan.
The prescriber will discuss the medicines on your individual plan. This sheet covers bevacizumab. Complete the separate consent for the selected chemotherapy partner before treatment.

context_regimen_profiles.regimen_role: 00215a covers first-line FIGO IIIB, IIIC or IV epithelial ovarian, tubal or primary peritoneal cancer with carboplatin and paclitaxel. 00215c covers platinum-resistant recurrence with five-day topotecan after no more than two prior chemotherapy regimens and no prior VEGF-directed treatment.
context_regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: Your team may add bevacizumab to initial chemotherapy for advanced ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer and then continue it alone. A different use is with five-day topotecan if the cancer has returned and is resistant to platinum. First-line treatment starts with chemotherapy. Bevacizumab starts in cycle 2 and is given every 21 days. After up to six chemotherapy cycles it can continue alone, up to 15 months (22 cycles) in total. In platinum-resistant recurrence it is given every 21 days with five-day topotecan until progression or unacceptable side effects.

priority_toxicities: Low blood counts and infection
Numbness / tingling, sometimes lasting
Hair loss, muscle or joint pain
Infusion reaction
Mouth, bowel, skin and nail effects
urgent_review_signals: Call the 24-hour oncology number immediately for fever, chills, bleeding or feeling suddenly unwell. Tell the nurse immediately about flushing, breathlessness, dizziness, throat tightness or pain at the infusion site.

longitudinal_schedule.title: Your checks

rows.label: Before starting
cells: Full blood count, kidney and liver function.
Bring a list of medicines and tell the team about previous treatment reactions.

rows.label: Before each treatment
cells: Blood count, kidney and liver function.
Tell the team about fever, mouth ulcers, diarrhoea, numbness or problems using your hands or walking.

rows.label: Day 8
cells: Check the full blood count, kidney and liver tests before the day-8 dose.
Speak to the team if bloods have not been arranged for a treatment visit.

rows.label: Response review
cells: Symptoms, examination and scans according to your treatment plan.
Ask whether CA125 is informative in your situation and when results will be discussed.

longitudinal_schedule.note: Your team may arrange additional checks based on your results and symptoms.

evidence_audit.coverage_summary: Some participants with previously treated ovarian cancer had tumour shrinkage with paclitaxel.
remaining_uncertainties: This was a small, single-arm study. It cannot show a survival advantage or establish the best dose or schedule for you.
covered_contexts: 00621c covers second-line metastatic ovarian cancer after failure of platinum-containing treatment. This weekly schedule is outside the Irish product licence.
